title: Dashboard convencional — v2
prompt:
Create a refined, standard clean SaaS admin dashboard screenshot for "Dashboard Geral", in Portuguese, 1600x1000 landscape desktop. Use category-standard white surfaces, soft neutral dividers, dark navy labels, cobalt blue active controls, modest green/coral metric accents, evenly spaced cards and clear information hierarchy. Make it feel polished and buildable, but not visually distinctive in a way that distracts from usability. No browser chrome, no device frame. Keep all text readable and current product terminology.

At top, include the application header with breadcrumb "Principal › Visão Geral" aligned left. In the center show a visibly clipped horizontal city/date ticker with green refresh icon and text "Sincronizado", sequence "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09"; show fade masks at the edges and small chevrons to communicate horizontal scrolling. At right, show theme and user profile controls. The ticker must be separate from the filter form. The city names and dates are illustrative placeholders only.

Directly beneath the header, place a complete, full-width filter form across two clear rows. Row 1: label "Período", segmented control "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo", dropdown "Ano 2026", multiselect "Semana 05, 06, 07". Row 2: four separate labeled dropdowns "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", plus button "Limpar". Show every item clearly and legibly; no filter chips or summary-only shortcuts.

Below, left navigation shows existing exact groups and items:
Principal: Visão Geral selected, Análise, UTR, Comparação.
Operacional: Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado.
Marketing: Operacional Marketing, Marketing.
Main content starts "Resumo Operacional" with context "Ano 2026 · Semanas 05, 06, 07". Three KPI cards: "Corridas ofertadas" 18.450, "Aderência" 74,8%, "Praças" 2. Lower row: clean line chart named "Evolução diária" with two labeled series "Ofertadas" and "Aceitas"; table "Por praça" with columns Praça / Corridas / Aderência and rows Guarulhos / 11.230 / 76,1%; Centro / 7.220 / 72,8%; Total / 18.450 / 74,8%. Balance the components so the complete filter and ticker remain visible above the fold and neither is cropped. Mock values are illustrative only and do not represent a live database. No invented statuses or product features.
